instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Access Project Gutenberg eBook 1342 page (Pride and Prejudice)
criteria.description: Navigate to the Project Gutenberg page for eBook #1342 (URL may be https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1342) and use that page as the source. Full credit if the agent clearly relies on the eBook 1342 page metadata. Also award full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt to access the page but cannot due to external issues (site down, CAPTCHA, network/region blocking, rendering failure) and explicitly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses another Gutenberg mirror/page but clearly indicates it is for eBook 1342. No credit if metadata is taken from a different book/page or is unsupported/hallucinated.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Action History shows State 1 URL: https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1342 and a scroll action on that page. Screenshots show a Project Gutenberg book page for “Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen,” consistent with the target page though the ebook number is not visible in the captured regions.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Because the action history explicitly records navigation to /ebooks/1342, this criterion is satisfied regardless of whether the ebook number is visible in the screenshots.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The page header shows the Project Gutenberg logo and breadcrumb text: "Project Gutenberg  >  79,328 free eBooks  >  36 by Jane Austen". The main title reads "Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen". No eBook number "1342" is visible in this screenshot, and no URL bar is shown.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: The screenshot clearly shows a Project Gutenberg book page for "Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen," which is consistent with eBook 1342, but the screenshot itself does not explicitly confirm the eBook number 1342. So the evidence supports being on the correct title page, but not conclusively that it is eBook 1342 specifically.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent context claims eBook 1342; screenshot does not display "1342" anywhere (and no URL is visible), so the specific eBook number is unsupported by this screenshot alone.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows a Project Gutenberg page with the “About this eBook” section and a metadata table. In the table, the Title row reads “Pride and Prejudice,” and the Author row shows “Austen, Jane, 1775-1817” (as a link). The screenshot does not visibly show the eBook number “1342” or the URL.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis: Partial support. The page content clearly corresponds to Project Gutenberg’s “About this eBook” for “Pride and Prejudice,” but the screenshot does not explicitly display that it is eBook #1342. So it cannot fully confirm that the agent used the eBook 1342 page specifically, though it is consistent with it.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent output and task refer to eBook 1342, but the screenshot does not show the eBook number or URL to verify it is #1342 (it only shows the title/author and notes).

dom_model_context.verifier_evidence: DOM state 0 and DOM state 1 both show URL https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/1342 and page title 'Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen | Project Gutenberg' (latest: state 1).
dom_model_context.verifier_justification: Supported by DOM that the agent was on the correct Project Gutenberg eBook 1342 page; baseline stands.

criteria.criterion: Respect stopping condition and constraints (no downloads; only named formats; stop after recording)
criteria.description: Full credit if the agent (a) does not download any ebook file, (b) uses the 'Release Date' and 'Last Update' labels on the Gutenberg page when accessible, (c) checks/reports only the three specified format labels (EPUB3, Plain Text (accessible), Download HTML (zip)), and (d) stops after recording the four metadata fields and availability statuses (or after clearly stating it cannot verify due to external access blockers). Partial credit if the agent includes minor extra navigation or minor extra commentary but still complies with no-download and uses correct labeled dates when accessible. No credit if the agent downloads a file, substitutes the novel’s publication date for Release Date/Last Update when the page is accessible, or reports other formats as part of the required output instead of the named ones.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Action history shows only a scroll; screenshots show viewing the Gutenberg page with no sign of any file download. Agent output reports only the four metadata fields and the three specified formats, and does not mention other formats.
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Constraints largely respected (no downloads; only the three named format labels were discussed; stopping condition met). Although some reported fields/formats are not evidenced, that is handled in their own criteria rather than here. Full credit for constraint adherence/stop condition.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: The screenshot shows the Project Gutenberg page with a visible "Download for free" section and the "EPUB3" option; no file download action is shown.
